notes: The dashboard is now an actual vehicle dashboard. The cockpit box, the favourites grid and the status card are gone - all three were chrome, and everything they reached is a dock button or already in Settings. In their place, three zones fed live by the CAN service: DRIVE (speed, a P R N D S strip, rpm, handbrake and lights), VEHICLE (a top-down car drawn from your data - four doors and the boot turn red when open, seatbelts, headlights, indicators that blink, tyre pressure at each corner with a warning ring, and all 16 parking sensors arranged around the car, with reversing guides that bend with the steering), and VITALS (coolant, fuel, battery, steering angle). Every reading is always shown, with a dash where the car has not reported it - so the dashboard doubles as a map of what your J7 actually puts on the bus. A CAN dot in the top strip says whether the service is connected, connected but silent, or not bound, and taps through to the diagnostics. New in Settings: a vehicle strip that floats over CarPlay with gear, speed and indicators - passive, so it can never steal a tap - and a Demo data switch that fills the dashboard with invented readings so the layout can be checked with the engine off. Drawn with Compose Canvas, no new libraries, and the numbers use tabular figures so they stop jittering as they count.
